title: Sharp maximum estimates for linear uniformly elliptic equations with measurable coefficients
summary: In this paper we obtain sharp exponents in the Aleksandrov-Bakelman-Pucci maximum estimate for linear uniformly elliptic equations with measurable coefficients, originally conjectured by Pucci in 1966 \cite{Pucci}, together with corresponding sharp results under the more natural quantification of uniform ellipticity in more than two dimensions. The proofs combine a Hessian integral inequality obtained from boundary Morse inequalities with an obstacle argument. The estimates also hold on arbitrary open sets, of finite volume, without regularity assumptions on their boundaries.
